truth_rules.current_selector: This file alone selects live operational state.
truth_rules.implementation_facts: Use live repository, PR, CI, filesystem, and tool evidence.
truth_rules.legacy_surfaces: Legacy selectors are compatibility projections or history only and may not override this file.
truth_rules.cross_program_successor_rule: Before successor selection, consult governance/application-planning/ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json. Individual program strict_successor or backlog fields cannot skip an eligible interstitial program or override cross-program gates.
truth_rules.executor_independence: Executor availability never grants or revokes project authority.
truth_rules.parallel_lane_rule: GPR, MRCS and OARC execute independently on distinct implementation branches and distinct lane-state refs. Terminal MSAS remains readable completed history and occupies no persistent execution slot. One lane never reserves future access to main; shared-repository publication is serialized only among immutable READY candidates.
truth_rules.protected_main_interlock: For cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app and cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc, direct main writes are prohibited. Only the FIFO READY head may merge after a green drift-sensitive integration receipt against fresh main. There is no active holder or turn_base that freezes main during implementation.
truth_rules.persistent_execution_lanes: OPS3 preserves exactly three independent persistent implementation lanes: gpr, mrcs and oarc. MSAS-21, MVPS-23 and UISR-11 are completed program history and do not occupy persistent implementation slots.
truth_rules.no_progress_loop: Repeated owner execution commands with unchanged material_progress_seq are OPS3.NO_MATERIAL_PROGRESS and require stall diagnosis/recovery before another ordinary execution cycle.
truth_rules.generated_main_writers: CI/bots/generated-content jobs may not push directly to protected main; generated outputs must be present on the queue-bound candidate branch or validation fails closed.
truth_rules.ready_then_queue: Publication order begins only after immutable exact-head prequeue validation is green. The queue has no reservation-for-future-work, active holder, heartbeat, release, or recovery-release lifecycle.
truth_rules.lane_state_isolation: Live execution progress for persistent lanes is recorded on ops3-lane-state/gpr, ops3-lane-state/mrcs and ops3-lane-state/oarc. Terminal MSAS lane state is historical only. CURRENT selects work globally; lane-state refs cannot select successors or mutate another lane.
truth_rules.executor_interruption: A chat/tool/session interruption is an executor incident, never a project lock. Resume from the last durable lane-state receipt and fresh repository/PR evidence; do not silently wait or replay completed phases.
truth_rules.overinstrumentation_guard: OPS3 uses milestone receipts, not activity receipts. Repository/PR/CI/publication-queue evidence owns mechanical transitions; status reads, polling, per-platform CI results, artifact inspection, queue mechanics and merge mechanics must not create lane-state receipts or be misclassified as material progress.
truth_rules.lane_state_milestones: Ordinary persistent-lane execution state is selected_not_started -> in_progress -> prequeue_green -> published, followed by one deterministic successor reseed after canonical closeout. The generic lane activity-log API is prohibited.
truth_rules.closeout_fast_path: After application publication, canonical closeout is one bounded phase: atomic closeout candidate validation -> READY CAS -> fresh-main integration check -> exact merge -> durable queue reconcile -> one successor reseed. No intermediate lane-state writes.
truth_rules.domain_authority_rule: When CURRENT.json names a domain authority relevant to the requested scope, that referenced authority defines current domain canon. Historical or generated domain material cannot override it; domain authority cannot select work or expand lane scope.
